title: US-short Cut 6-a momentum scoring-seam binding
description: Frozen schema-first contract for the offline batch5->batch4 momentum score-block seam (§4.2 40% momentum leg). Const-pins BOTH sides of the shared contract — the accepted producer-result key set, the block value domain + numeric policy, the sub-feature universe, the coverage row shape + partition policy, the disposition vocabulary, the projection output shape — plus the identity/producer refs and an all-gated authorization boundary, so the producer input shape and the composer output shape cannot silently drift before Cut 6 composition consumes them. Offline glue shape only; live fetch gated under SR-PROVIDER-001.

consumer_ref.const: batch4 score composer -> engine/us_short_weekend_analysis.py score_blocks['momentum'] -> engine/us_short_core_score.py

identity_policy.const: engine/us_short_eligibility_gate.py::canonical_us_ticker; one canonical identity per stock; plain str only (a str subclass is rejected before any method dispatch)

matrix_identity.const: coverage_matrix keys (canonical) must EXACTLY equal the union of momentum_block ∪ insufficient_history ∪ insufficient_coverage identities — no missing, no extra, no contradictory

history_relation.const: a ticker in insufficient_history has n_present == 0

insufficient_coverage_relation.const: a ticker in insufficient_coverage has 0 < n_present < min_coverage

duplicate_policy.const: reject a post-canonical duplicate within EVERY identity-bearing collection (momentum_block keys, coverage_matrix keys, insufficient_history, insufficient_coverage); never silently set-collapse

sub_feature_relation.const: sub_feature_coverage keys must exactly equal sub_feature_universe; each count is an exact int in [0, number_of_identities]

min_coverage_rule.const: min_coverage is an exact int in [1, len(sub_feature_universe)]

n_present_bound.const: each coverage_matrix n_present is an exact int in [0, len(sub_feature_universe)]

margin_conservation.const: Σ coverage_matrix n_present (row degrees) == Σ sub_feature_coverage counts (column degrees) — both count the same ticker×sub-feature incidence cells

margin_realizability.const: the row-degree (per-ticker n_present) and column-degree (per-sub_feature count) sequences must be jointly realizable as a binary ticker×sub-feature incidence matrix (Gale-Ryser)

neutral_fill_note.const: a target ticker that is insufficient_history / insufficient_coverage / absent_from_pool is NOT scored — it is reported in neutral_fill_tickers so the composer OMITS the momentum block and core_score applies the §4.2 neutral-block rule (never a fabricated momentum value).
